question: All of the following are true about Nizatidine except

options.opa: It is a H2 blocker used in peptic ulcer disease
options.opd: It can also lead to tachycardia

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Nizatidine is an H2 blocker" -> "used in peptic ulcer disease" -> "reduces gastric acid secretion" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Nizatidine does not enhance gastric emptying" -> "it primarily reduces acid secretion" -> "no evidence of prokinetic effects" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Nizatidine can cause side effects" -> "but tachycardia is not commonly associated" -> "more likely to cause dizziness or headache" -> 80%
analysis: Nizatidine is indeed an H2 blocker used in peptic ulcer disease (option opa is true). It has good bioavailability, but it is not 100% (option opb is misleading). Nizatidine does not enhance gastric emptying (option opc is false). While tachycardia is not a common side effect, it can occur in some cases (option opd is true). Therefore, the statement that it enhances gastric emptying is the incorrect one.
